business_overview.one_sentence: The group is an investment holding company engaged in used computer-related components, clothes and beauty product trading, securities brokerage/placing/underwriting, and money lending.

segments.name: Trading of used computer-related components, clothes and beauty products
segments.source: Annual Report 2025, Director's Statement and MD&A pp.2,4; revenue note 8 p.131

segments.name: Money lending
segments.source: Annual Report 2025, MD&A p.4; revenue note 8 p.131

business_overview.revenue_model: Goods revenue is recognised on delivery to wholesalers; securities commission is recognised on trade date or completion of placing/underwriting mandate; money lending revenue is interest income.
business_notes: 2025 net profit was mainly due to approximately HK$59.2 million FVTPL fair value gains.
The company has financial and investment holding characteristics, so customer money, securities trading balances and money lending assets cannot be treated as ordinary excess cash.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Listed equity fair value gain, not recurring operating cash profit
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025 consolidated statement of profit or loss p.65

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Realised trading gain from listed equity securities; excluded from operating cash profit because related principal is counted in detachable asset pool
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025 consolidated statement of profit or loss p.65

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Credit loss provision in money lending business

funds_assets.item: Cash and bank balances - house accounts and cash on hand
funds_assets.business_substance: Own cash/cash equivalents available to the group before operating cash reserve

funds_assets.item: Cash and bank balances - segregated client accounts
funds_assets.business_substance: Client money in securities dealing business; not available for group obligations

funds_assets.item: Amount due from a securities broker
funds_assets.business_substance: Deposit placed with broker for trading listed investments, repayable on demand

funds_assets.item: Financial assets at FVTPL - Hong Kong listed equity securities
funds_assets.business_substance: Listed shares held for trading, level 1 fair value
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 note 26 p.162 and fair value note 7 p.130

operating_assets.business_substance: Merchandise including clothes, beauty products and used computer-related components
Trade receivables, securities receivables, deposits, prepayments and other receivables
Money lending business asset, fixed interest 8%-10%, all recoverable within one year before ECL uncertainty

investment_assets.business_substance: Disposed or nil at 2025 year end
investment_assets.source: Annual Report 2025 consolidated statement of financial position p.67

other_assets.item: Deposits with Stock Exchange and HKSCC
other_assets.business_substance: Regulatory/clearing related deposits for securities business

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Unlisted unsecured five-year bond issued 30 May 2025, principal HK$5.0m, coupon 7%, effective rate 12%
No bank loan outstanding at 31 December 2025
Office lease liability; treated as continuing operating lease burden in owner earnback analysis rather than detachable cash debt deduction

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Includes securities client payables, trade payables, other payables and reinstatement provision

years.source: Annual Report 2025 statements pp.65,70-71 and note 18 p.150

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported profit is not a reliable cash denominator: 2025 profit was mainly FVTPL fair value gains, while operating cash flow was negative in 2023, 2024 and 2025.

gaps: The annual report does not disclose parent-company standalone cash versus subsidiary cash in enough detail for immediate dividend extraction analysis.
The FVTPL listed equity portfolio is not broken down by issuer, concentration or post-year-end liquidity.
Maintenance capital expenditure is not separately labelled; no PPE additions are disclosed, so it is treated as HK$0 for 2025 only.
Market capitalization comes from the run input rough screen, not from a contemporaneous exchange quote.
